question: Refer to the exhibit. Two Cisco Nexus Series Switches use EIGRP between their Eth1/1 interfaces. The switches are configured to support EIGRP authentication. Which set of CLI commands must be used to establish EIGRP neighborship?
context:
key chain EIGRP
  key 2
    key-string CISCO
!
router eigrp Pallini
  autonomous-system 10
  authentication mode md5
!
interface Ethernet1/1
  ip authentication key-chain eigrp Pallini EIGRP
options:
interface Ethernet1/1
ip router eigrp Pallini
ip authentication mode eigrp Pallini md5

interface Ethernet1/1
ip router eigrp 10
ip authentication mode eigrp Pallini EIGRP

interface Ethernet1/1
ip router eigrp 10
ip authentication mode EIGRP Pallini md5

interface Ethernet1/1
ip router eigrp Pallini
ip authentication mode md5 Pallini EIGRP
theory: EIGRP key-chain authentication on NX-OS requires the interface's authentication commands to reference the SAME EIGRP process identifier used elsewhere in the configuration (here, the named process 'Pallini', matching 'router eigrp Pallini'), and to explicitly select MD5 as the authentication algorithm with ip authentication mode eigrp Pallini md5, tying the interface to the key chain already bound in the exhibit. Mismatched process names or missing the md5 keyword would prevent the neighbors from ever forming an authenticated EIGRP adjacency. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 18 - Keychain Authentication, applied to NX-OS EIGRP)
